examples.description: Handoff: Rahul acknowledged INC-0104 and is now the owner. Padosi shows 'Owner: Rahul' on the incident timeline.
approve: Padosi runs the pending action (here: move KaamKaro's bulk-ingest requests to the heavy lane).
reject: Padosi does not run the pending action; the case stays open and the timer-based safe default applies.
extend: Padosi keeps the current action running past its timer (here: JhatpatMart stays on the VIP lane until the sale ends).
release: Padosi undoes the current action now (here: return server w4 to service).
resolve: Padosi closes the incident; no further actions.
